report.question_or_target: What arrival schedule avoids a 429 storm at ten times fan-out, which quota binds first, and when would batch work starve interactive work?
report.answer: On the synthetic 20 RPM envelope: launch batch item i at t0+4*i seconds (15 batch RPM, 5 interactive reserved). A simultaneous 480-item burst yields 460 HTTP 429s; the live 3s stagger yields 0 HTTP 429s but starves interactive work at t=57s.
